property_summary: After any call to SetMinSum(x) on the correct contract, calling SetMinSum(x) again always reverts if the contract was already initialized (i.e., reference disallows any SetMinSum after Initialized() regardless of value), whereas the mutant allows non-zero changes after initialization (only blocks when _val==0), so there exists an input value that makes the mutant accept a SetMinSum call post-initialization while the reference would have reverted.
change_summary: Change guard to only revert when already initialized true and input is zero (allows changing MinSum to non-zero even after initialization).
